events.title: Passenger shuttle runs its route

participants.note: short-hop dress of the express role; window row is the read

events.arrangement: Fixed two-stop route flown identically each window: dock, board, transit, dock
events.startConditions: Schedule tick; express-role spawn with the short-hop flag
events.visibleCue: The same lit-window hull at the same times on the same line - the region acquires a bus, and with it a clock

phases.name: board
phases.visible: Docked at the passenger face; cabin rows lit; the hauler_dock profile runs pax-flavored

phases.name: transit
phases.visible: Level, unhurried lane transit - never overtakes, never yields more than it must

phases.name: arrive
phases.visible: The long flat buttered stacking approach that is the brand

events.completion: Docks at the far stop; reverses next window - the route IS the aftermath

interruptions.outcome: Shuttle waits at the last safe point, windows lit - passengers visibly delayed, the region's problems given a face

playerInterference: Escort it through a bad pocket unasked
Interdict it and meet the fastest patrol response in the game
events.criminalOpportunity: A schedule is a promise, and promises can be ambushed - but the response doctrine prices it accordingly
events.aftermath: Persistent schedule; other events can reference 'after the shuttle passes' as a natural clock
events.fallback: Hull lost: route pauses one window then a replacement runs it - the ROUTE outlives the vehicle, which is the point

events.title: Small craft stops at the overlook
environment: scenic point: hero planet sightline, wreck cathedral, or landmark rock
events.arrangement: Small hull leaves the lane, parks at the overlook facing the VIEW (not the lane, not a rock face - the view)
events.visibleCue: A parked hull aimed at nothing minable, dockable or scannable - the only explanation left is that it is LOOKING

phases.name: drift_in
phases.visible: Casual approach, running lights dimming to parking trim

phases.name: linger
phases.visible: Station-keeping aimed at the view; tiny attitude corrections track the sight-line - the hull is watching, visibly

phases.name: move_on
phases.visible: One slow pass ALONG the view before rejoining the lane - the last look

events.completion: Rejoins traffic; nothing gained but the view - which is the entire message about this universe

interruptions.outcome: Leaves immediately - sightseers are the region's canary

playerInterference: Park alongside and share the view (the game's cheapest co-presence moment)
Rob a sightseer and learn how little they carry
events.criminalOpportunity: Sightseers mark SAFE pockets by existing - their absence marks the opposite; both reads are free intel
events.fallback: Overlook unresolvable: the roll fizzles silently
events.notes: The cheapest pure-texture event in the library: one parked hull aimed at scenery converts the region's landmarks into destinations.

events.title: Memorial convoy circles the great wreck
environment: major wreck site (dead hulk / cathedral class)
candle-fleet lamp props (billboard-buoy family's 24-light memorial exists as donor)
events.arrangement: Mixed civilian hulls form a slow single-file ring around the wreck at 60 wu, lights at half; patrol holds far off, dark, out of respect
events.startConditions: Anniversary tick on the wreck site's record (seeded date), or aftermath of a large multi-wreck event
events.visibleCue: Working hulls arriving in ones and twos and NOT working - trades that never share a pocket falling into one slow file

phases.name: gather
phases.visible: Arrivals take ring stations in silence; every trade's lamps at half-trim - the working light dimmed is the working world's black armband

phases.name: orbit
phases.visible: One slow full circuit in single file; at the wreck's bow each hull flashes ONCE - roll call for the dead

phases.name: candle_drop
phases.visible: Each hull releases one small lamp pickup into a trailing constellation - the candle fleet, laid fresh

phases.name: disperse
phases.visible: File breaks up by trade, each hull returning to work - grief with a shift to finish

events.completion: A ring of lamp pickups glows around the wreck until they fade - the region visibly remembers

interruptions.trigger: ANY weapons fire in the pocket
interruptions.outcome: Instant dispersal; the patrol - dark until now - lights everything at once; desecration has the fastest response in the region

playerInterference: Join the file and drop a candle (proximity + jettison; the game credits it)
Steal candles (the single most despised legible act available)
events.criminalOpportunity: Every working hull in the region is HERE, which means everywhere else is empty - the memorial empties the map for exactly its duration
events.aftermath: Candle lamps persist and fade over the session; the site's record notes attendance (campaign valence)
events.fallback: Attendance below three hulls: the few that came fly the circuit anyway - smaller grief, same shape
events.diagramMermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant W as Wreck site
  participant F as Civilian file
  participant P as Patrol (dark)
  F->>W: hulls gather, lamps at half
  F->>W: single-file orbit begins
  Note over F,W: one flash each at the bow - roll call
  F-->>W: candle pickups released in trail
  P->>P: holds far off, unlit
  F->>F: disperses by trade
  Note over W: candle ring glows and slowly fades

events.title: Two prospectors argue over a site in movement
events.arrangement: Both arrive within seconds; the argument is flown - orbits, cut-offs, feints - and settled without a shot
events.startConditions: Two prospector-variant miners resolve the same unstaked target
events.visibleCue: Two small hulls circling one rock in OPPOSITE directions - the geometry of disagreement

phases.name: simultaneous_claim
phases.visible: Both hard-stop at the rock, nose to nose across it

phases.name: posture
phases.visible: Counter-rotating possession orbits, each cutting inside the other's line, closer and closer - chicken at two metres per second

phases.name: break
phases.visible: One blinks: peels off in a flat, sulky departure line. The winner immediately fires its stake - punctuation

phases.name: settle
phases.visible: Winner begins the ordinary claim ritual (circle + cut); loser hunts elsewhere, visibly faster than before

events.completion: One stake, one grudge, zero shots - the belt's civil justice at work

interruptions.outcome: Both freeze their orbits and PAINT you in turn - united against the outsider, instantly

playerInterference: Stake the rock yourself while they posture (the ultimate third-party move - both then posture at YOU)
Back one side by mirroring its orbit
events.criminalOpportunity: The loser leaves knowing exactly where a rich rock is and who owns it thinly - tomorrow's claim-jump event, seeded today
events.aftermath: Winner's stake persists; loser's next hunt weights toward the same field edge (the grudge has a heading); chains toward ev_claim_jump
events.fallback: Either despawns mid-posture: walkover claim for the survivor
events.notes: The brief's movement-only argument, in full: every beat is steering and lamps; no dialogue system is touched.

events.title: Work crews cluster at the cold locker
environment: cold locker prop (lane furniture class, exists)
events.arrangement: Working hulls converge on the locker mid-shift and park in a loose huddle, work lights OFF, nav trim only
events.startConditions: Shared work window midpoint (economy tick) with 2+ workers in the pocket
events.visibleCue: Every work light in the pocket dying within a minute of each other - lunch, legible from orbit

phases.name: down_tools
phases.visible: Cones, welds and floods die in near-sync across the pocket

phases.name: huddle
phases.visible: Hulls drift to the locker and park nose-in like boots around a fire; small attitude wobbles read as conversation

phases.name: back_to_it
phases.visible: One hull relights first and the rest follow inside twenty seconds - somebody is always the foreman

events.completion: Every trade back at its work; the locker sits alone again until next window

interruptions.outcome: Break ends instantly; workers scatter to their sites - a huddle is also a headcount of who can flee

playerInterference: Park in the huddle (nobody stops you; the wobbles continue around you)
Raid the pocket DURING break - every worksite is momentarily unattended
events.criminalOpportunity: Break time is the pocket's scheduled blind spot, and the locker's clock is public
events.fallback: Locker prop absent: the huddle forms around the largest worker instead - the ritual outranks the furniture

events.title: Off-shift couriers race the lane markers
environment: two lane pins ~200 wu apart (lane furniture, exist)
events.arrangement: Three couriers line abreast at a pin, sprint to the far pin, hairpin, return - an informal drag strip on public furniture
events.visibleCue: Small hulls forming a LINE ABREAST - freight files, patrols ring, only racers line up

phases.name: form_up
phases.visible: Three abreast at the pin, holding station badly - twitchy with intent

phases.name: sprint
phases.visible: Simultaneous full burn to the far pin; the formation shears as skill differs

phases.name: hairpin
phases.visible: Three different turn styles at the pin - wide, tight, and one who brakes too late every time

phases.name: run_home
phases.visible: Return leg; the winner crosses and flashes its floods twice - bragging in the public code

events.completion: They disperse to ordinary courier work as if nothing happened - because officially, nothing did

interruptions.outcome: Instant innocent dispersal to random headings - the universal guilty scatter, for the pettiest possible guilt

playerInterference: Join the line (adjacency at form_up enrolls you; beat them and the flood-flash is yours)
Bet with yourself - the wide-turner never wins
events.criminalOpportunity: Racing lines teach the fastest paths through the pocket's clutter - free routing intel from watching
events.aftermath: None. That is what makes it civilian
events.fallback: A racer despawns: the remaining two race anyway - two-boat clubs are still clubs

events.title: Dock rush hour at shift change
events.arrangement: Four hulls converge on one dock window; a visible holding stack forms - two out, one circling, one waved in
events.startConditions: Economy tick aligns multiple job cycles' dock phases (deliberately schedulable)
events.visibleCue: The approach lane filling from empty to four contacts in a minute - the region keeps office hours and this is five o'clock

phases.name: converge
phases.visible: Arrivals from three bearings; the first takes the dock, others peel into a visible holding ellipse

phases.name: cycle
phases.visible: Dock face runs continuous hauler_dock profiles; each departure crosses an arrival - the two-way door

phases.name: thin_out
phases.visible: Ellipse empties one hull at a time until the face idles again

events.completion: All docked or departed; the pocket's population visibly redistributed station-ward and back

interruptions.trigger: Dock blocked (player parks in the window)
interruptions.outcome: The ellipse GROWS - the world queues behind you, patiently and visibly

playerInterference: Dock mid-rush and take your place in the cycle
Watch the ellipse to count the region's working hulls - a census, free
Rob the holding pattern: parked, loaded, and predictable
events.criminalOpportunity: Rush hour concentrates every loaded hull at one point twice per window - the richest schedule the region publishes
events.aftermath: Station inventory jumps; the next work window starts staggered (the cycle breathes)
events.fallback: Station slot unresolvable: hulls disperse to secondary destinations - rush hour cancelled by the venue
